blocks.text: Apartment Cleanout Services in Oshawa, Ontario — Because Units Change Hands, and Stuff Gets Left Behind

c: Few cities turn over more apartments than Oshawa. Students arrive and leave with the school year, tenants move up and move on, investors flip units, families downsize — and almost every changeover leaves a unit full of things someone has to deal with. That someone can be us. Our fully insured Oshawa crew walks the unit with you, quotes one free flat price on the spot, and clears everything — furniture, appliances, closets, lockers — usually the same day you call.

blocks.text: Simcoe Street Towers, Campus-Area Rentals, Lakeview Walk-Ups — Oshawa Units Are Our Daily Work

Between the apartment towers along Simcoe, the student rentals surrounding Durham College and Ontario Tech in the north end, and basement units woven through McLaughlin, Eastdale and Vanier, Oshawa keeps a cleanout crew busy year-round. Live Junk Free has built 660+ five-star Google reviews doing exactly this work — for tenants racing a lease date, landlords facing a full unit, and families clearing a loved one's apartment with care.

items.title: Volume in, price out — the formula never changes

blocks.text: Whatever fills a quarter of the truck costs quarter-truck money; whatever fills it all costs full-load money. Nothing else — not the hours, not the flight of stairs, not the wait for the elevator, not which Oshawa neighbourhood the building sits in — touches the price.

items.title: We price the unit we can see, not the one you describe

blocks.text: Apartments are deceptive: a "mostly empty" unit often hides a stuffed closet, a loaded balcony and a locker in the basement. Our quotes come after an in-person look at all of it. Free, flat, and yours to turn down.

items.title: One approved figure covers the job end to end

blocks.text: Carrying, dismantling, hallway protection, hauling, tipping fees, fuel — it all lives inside the single number you approve before we start. Whatever the unit reveals along the way changes nothing on your invoice.

items.title: Landlords get a unit back, not a bigger problem

blocks.text: Turnover cleanouts are about the next tenant, so we work to that standard: everything out including what's stuck to the back of closets, common areas protected and left spotless, before-and-after photos on request, and units returned swept and showable — sometimes within hours of the call.

items.title: Quote first, decide second, pay only if we work

blocks.text: There's no fee for the walkthrough and no pressure after the number lands. Approve it and the clearing starts immediately; decline it and we're gone with a handshake. Approved prices are locked and final.

items.title: Independent pricing runs 30–50% under the big chains

blocks.text: Franchise trucks carry franchise fees in every quote. Ours don't — we're locally owned with no royalties to pay — which is why the identical Oshawa cleanout consistently costs 30–50% less with us.

text: Show us the unit and everything attached to it — balcony, locker, storage cage. We size the whole job and hand you one flat, all-inclusive quote, free of charge and free of pressure.

Frequently Asked Questions About Apartment Cleanouts in Oshawa, ON

items.q: Q: What does an apartment cleanout run in Oshawa?
a: A: Truck volume is the only dial. Small loads start at $125, one-bedrooms typically land mid-range, and packed units cost more because they fill more — always as one flat figure quoted free inside the unit before anything moves. Stairs, elevators and building quirks are included, never extra.

items.q: Q: My tenant moved out and left the place full. How fast can you clear it?
a: A: Often same-day, almost always within a day or two. Once you’ve satisfied Ontario’s rules around a former tenant’s belongings, call us — we clear the unit completely, photograph before and after if you want records, and hand back a swept apartment ready to show. Plenty of Oshawa landlords have us saved in their contacts for this exact scenario.

items.q: Q: Do you do student apartment cleanouts near Durham College and Ontario Tech?
a: A: Every spring and fall, in volume. Whether you’re a student leaving town, a parent handling it from a distance, or a landlord resetting a shared house between school years, campus-area cleanouts are one of our most practiced Oshawa services — and volume pricing keeps a single room’s worth cheap.

items.q: Q: The building has an elevator booking / insurance requirement — is that an issue?
a: A: Standard procedure for us. Tell us the elevator window when you book and we’ll load within it; if property management needs a certificate of insurance, we’ll have documentation sent over before cleanout day. Buildings run smoother when the crew knows the rules — so we ask up front.

items.q: Q: Is a basement apartment harder or pricier to clear?
a: A: Neither. Narrow stairs and side-door entrances just mean more careful carrying — which is our job, not your fee. The price stays volume-based no matter how the unit exits.
